graveyard.name: Kakariko Graveyard
graveyard.arrival: The royal tomb stands at the far end. Fresh flowers mark the gravekeeper's resting place on the west side.

dampe_race.name: Beneath the gravekeeper's stone
dampe_race.arrival: Speak to Dampe at the lantern. Follow him through the passages; closing gates punish losing his trail. E returns you to the start after a failed attempt.

shield_grave.name: A forgotten soldier's grave
shield_grave.arrival: A weathered chest rests beyond the candles.

royal_tomb.name: Royal Family's Tomb
royal_tomb.arrival: Bats stir above the burial chamber. The inscription is sealed until the chamber is quiet.

heart_grave.name: The sunless chamber
heart_grave.arrival: A royal inscription reads: light that sleeps within a melody can wake even this place.

windmill.name: Kakariko Windmill
windmill.arrival: A timber shaft rises through the gallery. The upper passage connects to the gravekeeper's underground course.

graves.name: Dampe's grave
graves.epitaph: DAMPE · The gravekeeper's legacy waits below. Follow the light; keep your feet.

graves.name: Soldier's grave
graves.epitaph: A shield may outlast the arm that bore it.

graves.name: Unmarked grave
graves.epitaph: The sun remembers those who sleep in darkness.

mountain_guard: The road is open. The castle fell seven years ago; people who escaped found shelter here. The cemetery lies east of the village.
anju: These used to be quieter streets. I still care for the cuccos, but the refugees need a place to sleep too. Dampe passed away during those seven years.
carpenter: We made room for the people from the market. The graves are east, past the last house. A strange light moves under Dampe's stone.
windmill_keeper: That tune! A child played it seven years ago and the windmill would not stop. Come inside; I have never forgotten it.
